recommendations.rationale: Baseline T95 mean 95.4589 s (CI 88.81-102.10). Adding east exit at [14.45,2.0]-[14.45,4.0] plus widening E2 to 5.0m gives T95 mean 42.1789 s (CI 41.11-43.24), diff -53.28 s, p=3.88e-13, no CI overlap. Hotspots showed E1 carried 79.7% of people; new exit takes 37.2% share balancing load. Uses 2 changes (<=3).

limitations: This tool supports decisions; it is not a safety certification.

Results based on 20 replicas, 200 occupants in spawn-1, same run settings (time cap, speeds, reaction times) as baseline; model assumptions and geometry as in layout summary with 2 baseline exits E1 and E2.
Total-time and mean-egress means hit the 240 s time cap in baseline; T95 is the decision metric for minimize_t95.
summary: Recommend adding east exit [14.45,2.0]-[14.45,4.0] and widening E2 to 5.0m: T95 95.46s -> 42.18s, significant, N-1 tested.
